author: smcarus
title: Will Ghana's government debt ratio fall in 2026?
summary: Give the probability that IMF WEO general government gross debt for Ghana, in % of GDP, is lower for 2026 than for 2025, both as first read on or after 1 May 2027 (after the April 2027 WEO).
knownLimits: The 2026 figure in the April 2027 WEO is still an IMF estimate and may be revised later; the first reading stands.
Ghana's debt restructuring changes the ratio through the terms agreed with lenders as much as through the budget.
Ghana must be on your watchlist for its latest figure to show on this page; the result is settled from the published series either way.
